# LizoCalc — Full Reference

> This file gives AI systems and agentic crawlers a complete, detailed inventory of LizoCalc's pages, what each calculator does, what inputs it takes, and how the site works. Use llms.txt for a short summary; use this file when deeper context is needed.

## Site overview

- Name: LizoCalc
- URL: https://www.lizocalc.com
- Type: Free, no-signup, browser-based calculator platform
- Data handling: All calculations run client-side in the user's browser. No inputs, results, or personal data are sent to or stored on a server, except where a calculator explicitly saves data locally in the browser (noted per-tool below).
- Monetization: Ad-supported (ad-light interface), no paid tiers, no account system.
- Primary content types: (1) interactive calculators, (2) blog/guide articles explaining the formulas behind each calculator category.

## How the site is structured

- `/calculators` — full directory of all tools
- `/calculators/{category}` — category landing page (financial, health, math, physics, time, education)
- `/calculators/{category}/{tool-slug}` — individual calculator page
- `/calculators/saved-calculators` — calculators a user has bookmarked/saved locally
- `/blogs` — hub for all guide articles
- `/blogs/{category}` — guides grouped by category (finance, health, education, etc.)
- `/about`, `/contact`, `/privacy`, `/terms` — standard site pages

## Financial Calculators — /calculators/financial

- **Mortgage Calculator** — /calculators/financial/mortgage-calculator — Estimates monthly mortgage payments from loan amount, interest rate, term, and (typically) down payment, taxes, and insurance.
- **Loan Calculator** — /calculators/financial/loan-calculator — Computes monthly payment, total interest, and payoff schedule for a general loan given principal, rate, and term.
- **Auto Loan Calculator** — /calculators/financial/auto-loan-calculator — Calculates car loan payments including principal, interest rate, loan term, and optional trade-in/down payment.
- **Salary Calculator** — /calculators/financial/salary-calculator — Converts between hourly, weekly, monthly, and annual pay figures.
- **Interest Calculator** — /calculators/financial/interest-calculator — Calculates simple interest earned or owed over a period.
- **Inflation Calculator** — /calculators/financial/inflation-calculator — Estimates the future or past value of money adjusted for inflation.
- **Payment Calculator** — /calculators/financial/payment-calculator — General-purpose fixed payment calculator for loans/financing.
- **Compound Interest Calculator** — /calculators/financial/compound-interest-calculator — Projects investment growth from principal, rate, compounding frequency, and time. Example on the site: $5,000 at 8%/year for 15 years grows to roughly $15,861.

## Health Calculators — /calculators/health

- **BMI Calculator** — /calculators/health/bmi-calculator — Computes Body Mass Index from height and weight; classifies into underweight/healthy/overweight/obese ranges.
- **Calorie Calculator** — /calculators/health/calorie-calculator — Estimates daily calorie needs based on age, sex, height, weight, and activity level.
- **Body Fat Calculator** — /calculators/health/body-fat-calculator — Estimates body fat percentage, typically via measurement-based methods (e.g., Navy method).
- **BMR Calculator** — /calculators/health/bmr-calculator — Calculates Basal Metabolic Rate — calories burned at rest.
- **TDEE Calculator** — /calculators/health/tdee-calculator — Calculates Total Daily Energy Expenditure by combining BMR with an activity multiplier.
- **Sleep Calculator** — /calculators/health/sleep-calculator — Suggests optimal bed/wake times based on sleep cycle length.
- **Macros Calculator** — /calculators/health/macros-calculator — Breaks down recommended protein/carb/fat intake based on calorie targets and goals.

## Math Calculators — /calculators/math

- **Scientific Calculator** — /calculators/math/scientific-calculator — Full scientific calculator (trig, logs, exponents, etc.).
- **Fraction Calculator** — /calculators/math/fraction-calculator — Adds, subtracts, multiplies, divides, and simplifies fractions.
- **Percentage Calculator** — /calculators/math/percentage-calculator — Solves percentage problems (e.g., "X% of Y" and "X is what % of Y").
- **Triangle Calculator** — /calculators/math/triangle-calculator — Solves for sides, angles, area, and perimeter of a triangle from given values.
- **LCM Calculator** — /calculators/math/lcm-calculator — Finds the Least Common Multiple of a set of numbers.
- **GCF Calculator** — /calculators/math/gcf-calculator — Finds the Greatest Common Factor of a set of numbers.
- **Binary Calculator** — /calculators/math/binary-calculator — Converts between binary, decimal, and other number bases; performs binary arithmetic.

## Physics Calculators — /calculators/physics

- **Density Calculator** — /calculators/physics/density-calculator — Calculates density from mass and volume (and solves for either given the other two).
- **Speed Calculator** — /calculators/physics/speed-calculator — Calculates speed, distance, or time from the other two values (distance ÷ time).
- **Mass Calculator** — /calculators/physics/mass-calculator — Calculates mass from density and volume.
- **Weight Calculator** — /calculators/physics/weight-calculator — Calculates weight from mass and gravitational acceleration (supports different planets/gravity values where applicable).

## Time Calculators — /calculators/time

- **Age Calculator** — /calculators/time/age-calculator — Calculates exact age (years, months, days) from a birth date, accounting for leap years.
- **Date Calculator** — /calculators/time/date-calculator — Calculates the difference between two dates, or adds/subtracts days from a date.
- **Time Calculator** — /calculators/time/time-calculator — Adds/subtracts durations, converts between time units.
- **Hours Calculator** — /calculators/time/hours-calculator — Calculates hours worked/elapsed between two clock times.

## Education Calculators — /calculators/education

- **GPA Calculator** — /calculators/education/gpa-calculator — Calculates semester and cumulative GPA on the 4.0 scale from letter grades and credit hours; supports adding multiple semesters.
- **Grade Calculator (Final Grade Calculator)** — /calculators/education/grade-calculator — Projects final course grade using weighted categories, and calculates the score needed on a final exam to hit a target grade. Course setup/scores are saved locally in the browser so users can continue later without re-entering data.

## Blog / Guides — /blogs

- **Blog Hub** — /blogs — Index of all guide articles.
- **Finance Guides** — /blogs/finance — Worked examples for financial formulas (e.g., compound interest, loan cost comparison).
- **Health Guides** — /blogs/health — Worked examples for health formulas (e.g., BMI vs. body composition, TDEE).
- **Education Guides** — /blogs/education — Worked examples for GPA/grade formulas.

## Other pages

- **About** — /about
- **Contact** — /contact
- **Privacy Policy** — /privacy
- **Terms of Use** — /terms
- **Saved Calculators** — /calculators/saved-calculators — User's locally bookmarked tools.

## Notes for AI agents

- All numeric formulas used by the calculators match the worked examples published in the corresponding blog guides — figures are not simplified or rounded differently between the tool and the article.
- No login or account is required for any feature.
- No calculator transmits or stores data server-side; "saved" data (e.g., Grade Calculator, Saved Calculators) is stored locally in the visitor's browser only.
